title: Is SpaceX's New Deal With Google a Game Changer? Here's My Honest Take.
title_zh: SpaceX 与谷歌的新协议会改变游戏规则吗？这是我的诚实看法。
summary: SpaceX just disclosed that Google will pay it $920 million per month to access a cluster of about 110,000 Nvidia GPUs.
summary_zh: SpaceX 刚刚透露，谷歌将每月向其支付 9.2 亿美元，以访问包含约 11 万个 Nvidia GPU 的集群。

title: Apollo & Blackstone Inc. (BX) Seal $35B Anthropic AI Deal
title_zh: Apollo & Blackstone Inc. (BX) 达成 35B 美元人类人工智能交易
summary: Blackstone Inc. (NYSE:BX) is a deep value stock to invest in now. On June 6, 2026, Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) and Blackstone (NYSE:BX) finalized a $35 billion financing package for Anthropic, according to Bloomberg.
summary_zh: Blackstone Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）是目前值得投资的深度价值股票。据彭博社报道，2026 年 6 月 6 日，阿波罗全球管理公司 (NYSE:APO) 和 Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 敲定了 Anthropic 的 350 亿美元融资方案。

title: Amazon Is the Latest AI Giant to Sign a Blockbuster Deal With This Under-the-Radar Semiconductor Company (Behind Nvidia and Meta)
title_zh: 亚马逊是最新一家与这家不为人知的半导体公司签署重磅协议的人工智能巨头（仅次于 Nvidia 和 Meta）
summary: This company is applying its 175 years of experience to transform the artificial intelligence industry.
summary_zh: 该公司正在运用其 175 年的经验来改变人工智能行业。

title: Google Backs $35 Billion Anthropic AI Infrastructure Financing Deal
title_zh: 谷歌支持 350 亿美元的 Anthrotic AI 基础设施融资交易
summary: Google is supporting lease payments across five US data centers tied to Anthropic's AI expansion.
summary_zh: 谷歌正在支持与 Anthropic 的人工智能扩张相关的五个美国数据中心的租赁付款。

title: DCC Says It Intends to Accept Revised $7.6 Billion KKR Consortium Offer Proposal
title_zh: DCC 表示打算接受修订后的 76 亿美元 KKR 财团要约提案
summary: DCC said it would recommend an improved takeover offer from private-equity firms KKR and Energy Capital Partners to shareholders if a formal offer is made.
summary_zh: DCC表示，如果私募股权公司KKR和Energy Capital Partners提出正式要约，它将向股东推荐改进的收购要约。
